blurb: Valhalla Helicopters offers scenic helicopter tours around the Okanagan, including winery tours, elopement experiences, and wedding packages. They also provide commercial helicopter services such as logging and seismic operations. The company emphasizes safety and employs experienced pilots and maintenance staff.
